title: Implementing Switchport Port Security
summary: Configure Cisco Catalyst switch port security to restrict unauthorized MAC addresses, learn dynamic sticky MAC addresses, and configure violation shutdown and recovery.
learning_objectives: Configure switch access ports to enable port security
Set maximum allowed MAC addresses per port
Enable dynamic sticky MAC address learning
Configure and compare violation modes (protect, restrict, shutdown)
Diagnose and recover a port from the err-disabled state

source.origin: Independently authored educational guide replacing legacy courseware answer guide
